name: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!
label: Quest
description: A Smokywood Pastures' Thank You!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We at Smokywood Pastures appreciate the recovery of the stolen treats, friend. For that, we'd like to offer you a special gift... Presented by none other than Greatfather Winter himself!

Please, speak with Greatfather Winter, and he will give you your Feast of Winter Veil gift from us here at Smokywood Pastures. From our farm to your plate, it's always Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness... Thanks to you, of course!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The goblins told me that you have earned a special gift this holiday season, and I am pleased to give it to you. Here you go - have a wondrous Feast of Winter Veil this and every season in the future.
